name: Sousouki Reginald
source:
Black shadows lurk in the smog-filled city of Fatedelhi. They are known as pagans (ghosts), beings who were not able to be reborn and remain on Earth without a soul. Reginald Urbane is a vampire who joined the pagan-hunting group Twanbach after meeting two mysterious twins Vanessa and Veronica.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/03/01/march-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
黑影潜伏在烟雾笼罩的法特德里市中。人们称这些存在为“异教徒（幽灵）”，他们无法转生，失去灵魂后仍滞留人间。雷吉纳尔德·阿贝莱因是一名吸血鬼。与神秘双胞胎瓦妮莎和薇罗妮卡相遇后，他加入专门猎杀异教徒的特万巴赫组织。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/03/01/march-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
